code: void sc_asn1_print_tags(const u8 * buf, size_t buflen)
note: The fuzz input bytes are passed as the ASN.1 buffer that the implementation prints.
The input-controlled DER tag and length are parsed into tag and len for dispatch.
A BIT STRING value is printed based only on the parsed length and contents, so malformed bit-string metadata reaches the decoder.
The input-controlled unused-bits count is used in a shift expression while validating the final octet.
